ctx.x: Now you had that to count up and you better have it straight. If you didn't, they stand you to the board and make you write your name like my name was Isabella. They make me write a hundred times and I look at the teacher. She said, now you write on that side. I said, I said, how many? She said, write clean till your daddy come. And then when my daddy come again, we go home, my papa whoop him. Cause I had right to know it. See?
I better give you this back. Cause you don't want to lose that either. Can I help you put it up?
